title: 🔆🔅Tehran - September 21 - Jahanshahi, Iran's Army Ground Force Commander made remarks to Trump's threats: Army rapid-reaction and special forces are deployed at the borders for defense.
text:
🔆🔅Tehran - September 21 - Jahanshahi, Iran's Army Ground Force Commander made remarks to Trump's threats: Army rapid-reaction and special forces are deployed at the borders for defense."

"----- "

"SOT, Ali Jahanshahi, Commander of Ground Forces of Iran Army (Farsi): "By the grace of Almighty God, and through the efforts of our commanders, officials, and comrades, the Ground Forces [of Iran's Army] are now deployed across all the country's borders. Our special forces, rapid reaction forces, and special units are fully prepared to counter any form of aggression or violation of the borders of our country, the Islamic Republic of Iran.
